sharedContract.scope: Only these five proposed spells; no global interface adoption
sharedContract.cast: Actual acquired class/repertoire/rank9; base26RP plus actual strain/modifiers. Components V/S/F. Ordinary action/cost/strain/concentration then cast-interruption; no refund. Counterspell/Dispel use actual acquired cards, not titles. Ready only Action spells, pays/holds concentration now, expires at next regular own START, releases with actual Reaction and selections/recheck; no second cast/payment. Absolute Gate cannot use generic Ready.
sharedContract.clocks: Each actual regular actor START refreshes own budgets, ticks recharge and expires Ready/source-start durations; own START processes required Dying saves; own END processes source-end saves and actual idle vent. Scheduled events are not spell pulses. No extra turn is invented. Outside initiative use actual uninterrupted work/elapsed deadlines; switching modes preserves prior clock markers. Any roll is explicitly authored test input, never a recovered campaign result.
sharedContract.geometry: All exact fixture poses/body boxes, positive interior overlap and support volumes supplied. Ordinary movement uses current grid geometry; this proposal selects Euclidean point-to-point120ft center placement only, explicitly spell-local. No geometric metadata stands for undocumented creature anatomy. Full body groups need all feet/support and actual carrying pounds plus Load.

identity.name: Banishment
identity.printedEffect: Send a creature to another plane temporarily.
identity.status: NEW provisional authored playtest candidate; source Instantaneous metadata preserved as evidence

castAndSave.target: One actually perceived creature within 60 feet and line of effect, including the caster; not a corpse, image, soul record or unattended object.
castAndSave.commit: Validate known class/repertoire, V/S/F, Action, range/line of effect, affordability, concentration permission, obvious body/custody impossibilities and obvious transport blocks. Pay the actual final spell price and perform ordinary cast/counter timing. NEW concentration begins at legal cast commitment and displaces incompatible prior concentration normally.
castAndSave.save: NEW BAN-SAVE-01: target makes a Charisma save against the actual casting-class spell DC. Before rolling, target records admissionIntent = ACCEPT or RESIST. ACCEPT may either elect automatic failure or roll normally; if it rolls and fails, establishment is still voluntary. RESIST plus failed save is involuntary. Actual save bonuses/defenses apply, including Fate-Bound Boon IV +2 against banishment. Success creates no cell and no exile.
castAndSave.hardControl: On a failed save, establishment is one hard encounter-removal component under the existing source-character/target/encounter hard-control allowance. If that allowance cannot be claimed, no exile/cell is established and no soft fallback is invented. The paid cast remains spent.
castAndSave.oneLive: Only one live ordinary Banishment application may attach to the same creature. An attached target cannot receive a second application; no replacement, stacked cell or timer refresh.
castAndSave.preflightAddendum: Apply BAN-TRANSPORT-CLASS-02 and target-side restrictions before commitment when known. No Escape blocks admissionIntent=ACCEPT because Banishment enters extradimensional travel. Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not block this non-teleport planar displacement. A hidden/new blocker may still defeat establishment after costs commit under ordinary spell integration.
castAndSave.admissionIntent: Before the save, record ACCEPT or RESIST. ACCEPT is voluntary admission whether the target elects failure or actually rolls and fails. RESIST remains forced on a failed save. This Banishment-only predicate is used only where an exact source distinguishes voluntary extradimensional travel.

cell.classification: NEW narrowly scoped temporary Banishment spell-space; names no canonical plane
cell.planeIdentity: A distinct temporary extraplanar spell-cell generated by this spell. It is not identified with any named reviewed plane, afterlife, deity, Heartcell state, soul destination, natural origin or campaign era.
cell.coordinates: Cell-local x=east, y=north, z=up. Floor is z=0. The primary arrives with the center of its horizontal footprint at local (0,0) in its current orientation.
cell.initialGeometry: Initial horizontal extent equals the primary's actual footprint plus 5 feet of clearance on every side; round each total horizontal axis upward to the next 5 feet. Height equals actual occupied body height plus 5 feet overhead, rounded upward to the next 5 feet. Example: Medium 5x5 body with occupied height 6 feet starts in x[-7.5,+7.5], y[-7.5,+7.5], z[0,15]. A Tiny 2.5x2.5 body also receives a 15x15 horizontal cell after rounding.
cell.supportAndEnvironment: The entire current cell floor is level ephemeral support. The cell supplies ordinary light and a nonharmful spell-local sustaining medium sufficient for an admitted body's already-established respiration needs. This grants no stock, harvest, resistance, immunity, amphibious trait or cosmological fact.
cell.boundaries: Cell boundaries are opaque to mundane sight/sound and ordinary line of effect/passage. A source cannot target space beyond the current boundary and rely on later expansion to make that target legal.
cell.voluntaryGeometry: Voluntary body-size/shape changes follow their actual source and BODY_EQUIPMENT_PLAYTEST.md preflight against the current in-cell volume. Banishment does not expand first to legalize a voluntary change.
cell.mandatoryGeometry: An actual mandatory ending/reversion/death/body-lifecycle event is never failed, delayed or negated to preserve cell geometry. Resolve it first under its source. If the resulting current body needs more room, expand the cell outward after the mandatory event, only enough to contain all extant bodies plus 5 feet clearance. Expansion moves no body and creates no new target permission.
cell.materiality: Floor/walls/light/sustaining medium are ephemeral spell boundaries with no inventory identity, sale, harvest or residue.

agencyAndClocks.duration: NEW concentration, maximum 60 elapsed seconds from successful establishment. Record absolute deadline establishment+60 seconds. In initiative, preserve the equivalent tenth future regular-start marker only as a display aid; the absolute deadline controls cross-mode transitions.
agencyAndClocks.agency: Primary and any admitted visitors retain their actual Actions, Bonus Actions, Reactions, movement, concentration, conditions, HP, death saves, resources and class permissions. Banishment itself adds no Incapacitated, restraint, stasis, healing or rest.
agencyAndClocks.clocks: All existing condition, summon, concentration, Opening/Horn, Hunt, Stable/death and other real deadlines continue 1:1. Extra turns/initiative changes do not refresh them.
agencyAndClocks.ending: Caster may end its own concentration through the ordinary no-action concentration permission. Caster Incapacitated/concentration failure/end, the absolute deadline, successful Xi termination, actual dispel/end of this application, or suppression of this Banishment application initiates closure immediately. NEW Banishment-specific suppression rule: because suppression disables the exile/cell effect itself, suppression closes and ends this application rather than pausing it for later resumption.

transportAndCustody.primaryTransport: On successful establishment transport the same selected creature identity and only its genuine noncreature worn/carried gear within actual custody/carrying/dimensional limits.
transportAndCustody.separateBodies: No separate creature is converted into gear. A mount, carried passenger, swallowed separate creature, controlled companion or other distinct creature remains at origin. Before establishment, separate it into a legal origin placement if possible. If actual anatomy/restraint makes separation impossible, establishment fails atomically; paid cast/commit history remains, and the hard-control allowance is not spent because exile never established.
transportAndCustody.tethers: An external tether/fixture does not travel merely because attached. If no current rule permits legal separation and the selected body cannot move intact without transporting another body/fixed structure, establishment fails atomically.
transportAndCustody.objects: Record transported object IDs and custody. Consumed, destroyed, transferred or independently removed objects remain consumed/destroyed/transferred/removed. No ending event duplicates inventory.

admission.externalVisitor: A different creature can enter only through an independently legal source that truly reaches this generated cell, satisfies that source's destination knowledge/perception/range/cost requirements, and designates a fitting unoccupied footprint already inside the current cell. The current 49-source set does not prove a generic route to an unknown cell.
admission.internalCreation: An occupant may create/summon a body only through its actual source and only into a fitting unoccupied footprint it can currently perceive/target inside the cell. Pay the source's real Action/RP/frequency/concentration/command costs. No pre-cast cell expansion may supply missing target space or line of effect.
admission.postEstablishmentExpansion: After a visitor/created body legally establishes in an already-valid in-cell footprint, the cell may expand outward only to restore the ordinary 5-foot clearance around extant bodies. That expansion is not part of source preflight.
admission.effect: Admission does not attach Banishment to the secondary body and grants no reusable return route, destination knowledge, immunity, action or resource. Its own independent lifecycle remains real.

escape.rule: Any occupant may use an independently legal escape/travel source exactly as written, paying its actual costs and satisfying its own destination, perception, range, geometry and blocker requirements. Banishment supplies none of those prerequisites.
escape.primaryEscape: If the primary legally leaves the cell, the Banishment application ends immediately. In that same resolution sequence, BAN-CLOSE-03 settles every remaining secondary body/object, then destroys the cell even if it is already empty. The escaped primary is not pulled back.
escape.secondaryEscape: A secondary body that independently leaves remains at its legal destination and is absent from later closure.
escape.failure: A failed escape spends only source-defined costs/history and leaves the body in the cell.

closure.classification: NEW Banishment-only finite ending. The spell-cell ends; physical fit is then handed to the accepted canonical BODY_EQUIPMENT_PLAYTEST placement-conflict procedure rather than protected closure anchors.
closure.trigger: Every Banishment application ending invokes closure: deadline, concentration end, valid Xi/end/suppression, or primary legal escape. Invoke even for an empty cell; an empty ephemeral cell simply ceases.
closure.originPlane: At successful establishment snapshot the primary target's actual origin-plane identity as an opaque existing plane reference and its fixed world anchor/orientation. The anchor never rides with a later-moving platform/vehicle. This records location only and does not name or settle cosmology.
closure.secondaryAnchors: When a secondary body first legally establishes in the cell, record a deterministic origin-plane closure anchor by projecting its cell-local horizontal/vertical offset from the primary local origin onto the primary's fixed world axes. This creates metadata only: no origin-plane space is reserved, protected, excluded or altered.
closure.looseObjectAnchors: At closure start, carried gear remains with its actual carrier. For each genuinely loose surviving object, project its current cell-local position onto the primary fixed world anchor to obtain an item placement anchor. Consumed/destroyed/escaped objects are absent.
closure.mandatoryPlaneReturn: For every remaining extant body/corpse/object, end the extraplanar spell state and assign it to the snapshotted origin plane before physical placement. This transition is mandatory and is not a voluntary teleport.
closure.endpointBlockerException: NEW narrowly scoped Banishment terminal exception: if a current Dimensional Anchor or other true endpoint transport-prevention predicate would block this mandatory closure transition, ignore only that prevention predicate for the terminal return. Do not ignore physical terrain, occupancy, anatomy, support, death/body removal, item existence or any voluntary-travel rule. This exception grants no future transport privilege and cannot be used for escape or another spell.
creatureOrder: primary current body/corpse if still present
secondary creature bodies by stable admission order
closure.creaturePlacement: For each returned creature/corpse in order, apply BODY_EQUIPMENT_PLAYTEST.md Placement and involuntary endings at that entity's closure anchor: (1) normal current-anatomy space at same position; (2) legal squeeze under COMBAT_ACTION_PLAYTEST.md; (3) nearest legal adjacent placement in the same unobstructed region, using minimum displacement, then greatest overlap with the previous/anchor footprint, then the fixed neutral board order. It cannot pass through a wall, closed barrier or occupied space and does not search farther afield.
closure.multiEntityPlacement: Resolve entities in the stated stable order. A body already legally placed is ordinary occupied space for later entities. If that leaves a later entity with no same-anchor/squeeze/nearest-adjacent candidate, the later entity records a placement conflict; earlier legal placements are not undone.
closure.placementConflictState: If the inherited same-anchor → legal squeeze → nearest legal adjacent/same-unobstructed-region placement procedure produces no legal footprint, Banishment still ends and the cell is destroyed. Preserve the same extant identity on the snapshotted origin plane with placementConflict=true and a fixed closureAnchorReference. NEW BAN-CONFLICT-04 does not create a global body condition: it adds only Banishment-origin conflict semantics. The closureAnchorReference is the creature's logical spatial location for measuring range and evaluating source predicates while no legal occupied footprint exists. Do not grant movement, adjacency, occupancy, cover, squeezing, wall passage, overlap, flanking, support contact or other footprint-dependent benefits merely from that reference. Perception and line of effect are evaluated from the closureAnchorReference through the actual current terrain using the exact source's normal rules; solid barriers can therefore block them. Self-targeting and other effects that do not require a legal occupied footprint may still be used if all of their own prerequisites are met. Actions/Reactions are not categorically forbidden: evaluate each one by its actual activation, component, range, target, perception, path and geometry requirements. Ordinary movement cannot begin because there is no legal occupied footprint/path origin, but an independently legal relocation effect can resolve the conflict if it can lawfully use the anchor reference as its source location and establish a legal destination. All HP, Wounds, conditions, concentration, summon, death and other real clocks continue. Already-attached effects remain attached unless their own source ends them. When an obstruction is actually removed/changed so placement becomes possible, rerun the inherited placement procedure from the same anchor with the then-current anatomy; that mandatory normalization spends no movement and triggers no movement riders. When a legal relocation effect succeeds, move the same identity to its legal destination and clear placementConflict.
closure.fallingAndSupport: Evaluate real terrain/support at the closureAnchorReference for source predicates while placementConflict persists, but do not invent an occupied footprint. A conflicted body does not begin Falling merely because the reference point is unsupported; ordinary Falling begins when the body is actually placed in a legal unsupported footprint or a legal relocation establishes one. If closure itself finds a legal unsupported footprint, place the body there and start ordinary Falling immediately. Banishment never moves the body directly to ground.
closure.objects: After creature handling, settle loose noncreature objects by stable object-ID using the existing equipment rule: place at its anchor/current legal item position or nearest legal adjacent item position; if no legal drop exists, record that item's placement as pending. It continues to exist and is not duplicated, destroyed or used to displace another creature.
closure.deathAndRemoval: Mandatory death, source expiry, concentration ending, Polymorph reversion, actual-0-HP ending, cargo release and other true source events are never failed or delayed for Banishment geometry. A remaining corpse returns as that same corpse. A vanished/expired summon body is not recreated. Hunted Death/finality and ordinary item provenance remain unchanged.
closure.cellEnd: After every remaining identity is either legally placed, recorded as an origin-plane placement conflict/pending item, or confirmed absent, destroy the ephemeral cell immediately. No placement conflict keeps Banishment or its concentration alive.

currentInterfaces.spellShield: Banishment is generating rank 4 and therefore does not satisfy accepted Spell Shield rank 0–3 eligibility, regardless of discounts.
currentInterfaces.dimensionalAnchor: At establishment, Dimensional Anchor applies under its accepted endpoint rule and can defeat the planar transition. During voluntary escape it applies normally. At BAN-CLOSE-03 terminal ending, the mandatory-plane-return step uses only the narrowly scoped endpointBlockerException; physical fit is never ignored and is resolved afterward by BAN-PLACEMENT-HANDOFF-03.
currentInterfaces.resonanceBeacon: Beacon requires same-plane traveler/beacon. A Beacon outside the cell does not become same-plane. A Beacon created inside obeys its actual rules but does not create an outside destination.
currentInterfaces.xi: Xi Declare Contradiction can end the ongoing Banishment creature-target branch only through its actual Action, 60-foot perception, known spell record, caster+target consent and charge procedure. Isolation may make those predicates unavailable; possession alone is not remote release.
currentInterfaces.fateBound: Actual Oracle Fate-Bound Boon IV grants its +2 against banishment saves; no generic Oracle immunity exists.
currentInterfaces.paladin: NEW BAN-TRANSPORT-CLASS-02 applies only to ordinary Banishment: it is planar/extradimensional displacement, not teleportation. No Escape (/cards/41) blocks admissionIntent=ACCEPT because it expressly forbids voluntary extradimensional travel; it does not block RESIST+failed-save forced exile. Verdict Absolute (/cards/43) names only voluntary teleportation/invisibility, so it does not block either Banishment branch. Reign of Ashes (/cards/130) denies benefit from Dash/teleportation; it does not block Banishment. Chain of Duty still requires same plane.
currentInterfaces.cleric: Cleric Banish Unholy remains its own class card: WIS save, radiant damage/push and possible until-end-next-turn banishment rider. It does not borrow this ordinary spell's cell/save/duration.
currentInterfaces.nullSummons: A finite summoned body that is Null Disabled at 0 remains the same body while its source persists. Banishment does not heal/refresh it. Independent summon concentration/deadline/end remains real; if it ends in the cell, there is no body to eject.

transportClassification.rule: Ordinary Banishment is planar/extradimensional displacement. It is not teleportation. This classification exists only to adjudicate this spell against exact current predicates and does not redefine other planar effects.

paladinConsequences.No Escape: Blocks ACCEPT because the card expressly forbids voluntary extradimensional travel; does not stop forced RESIST+failed-save exile.
paladinConsequences.Verdict Absolute: Does not block Banishment because its card forbids only voluntary teleportation/invisibility.
paladinConsequences.Reign of Ashes: Does not block Banishment because its card denies benefit from Dash/teleportation and Banishment is not teleportation.

historicalProcedure.procedure:
PG9-Q01 — KEEP all seven placements and exact classAccess rows. Each ordinary cast uses the selected acquired class, its school, rank9, base26RP, V/S/F and real beginning hooks. Gate: Cleric Universal, Druid/Mage/Wizard Conjuration; the Transmutation placement grants no class route. Absolute Gate has no Druid route; Fortress has no Cleric route. Action for four; Absolute Gate requires600seconds. No generic upcast or Ritual tag. Spell-local completion never supplies acquisition.

PG9-Q02 — KEEP distinct source authority. Use existing plane/site identifiers with an actual geometric site record; generated cells and fortresses receive cast-owned spellSpace IDs, never names of canonical dominions. Source-backed named realms can be named without asserting site geometry or that mortal labels are identical. No Fire=Bastion, Shadowfell=Veiled Expanse, soul/native-plane inference or viewer-coordinate distance. Conditional test geometry is labelled fixture input, not a campaign discovery.

PG9-Q13 — NEW Banishment Gate selects exactly one existing explicit creature-type label at creation, fixed for that source. Elemental is demonstrable from accepted Water/Earth Pet profiles; no inference of Fiend/Fey/native plane from appearance or spell school. Another type requires a source-authenticated classification and complete actor profile. Both allies and enemies, including caster if it genuinely matches, qualify. No foe-only condition, CR limit or named-person filter. Unknown type remains unknown and gives no positive eligibility or public type diagnostic.

PG9-Q14 — NEW a fixed10ft by15ft vertical portal in clear perceived space within120ft. It is not a passive radius. Trigger exactly once when a complete qualifying body's legitimate voluntary or forced movement would cross its plane within the opening; mere touching, formation overlap, stationary occupancy and a type change without new crossing do not trigger. Formation cannot overlap bodies. No saving throw; automatic means deterministic subject to actual immunity, suppression, custody and hard-denial limits. Failed establishment leaves ordinary movement subject to its own physical rules and consumes no exile claim. Duplicate delivery of the same crossing ID cannot retry; a genuinely later crossing is new but cannot erase an already spent source-character/target/encounter hard guard.

PG9-Q15 — NEW gate concentration600seconds; each successful target has a distinct generated Banishment-style cell and independent60second deadline from actual admission. The gate's ending closes every still-live associated cell immediately. No generic home-plane return or death/despawn. Admission preserves ordinary agency, all action/condition/death clocks and sustaining nonharvestable cell environment. Each cell has its own primary. No shared crowd cage. An independently acquired escape which can really reach a known external site may work under its own rules; escaping primary ends only its cell, settles its remaining contents and does not close the gate.

PG9-Q16 — KEEP source-character/target/encounter combined hard-denial guard, including voluntary removal; no immunity exception. NEW every Banishment Gate uses its original creator as source character; claims across that character's hard-denial effects remain one existing allowance. Reserve only when exile actually establishes. Separate creators retain their actual separate guards. No second live primary exile of this family or ordinary Banishment on the same body, no extension of ordinary Banishment's primary slot into a global caster slot. Simultaneous triggers resolve current initiative order then stable source/cast IDs; first successful establishment wins. No soft replacement condition or delayed queued banish.

PG9-Q17 — NEW PG200-CELL-EXT expressly extends BAN-CELL-03, BAN-ADMIT-03, BAN-CLOSE-03, BAN-CONFLICT-04 and BAN-PLACEMENT-HANDOFF-03 solely to this spell's cells, including exact terminal endpoint-prevention exception. Transport only the qualifying primary and lawful noncreature gear; separate living passengers/mounts/swallowed bodies remain at origin only if lawful separation is possible, else atomic exile failure. Snapshot origin world pose at admission; later platform movement does not change it. Mandatory reversion/death/summon expiry occurs first; extant corpse returns, expired body does not. Loose items survive with custody resolved. Cell ends even when placement conflict remains; no spatial search beyond inherited same/squeeze/adjacent region, no resurrection or clock freeze. Unavailable type/anatomy is a narrow case hold.

PG9-Q29 — NEW stable event/cast/transit IDs, snapshot graphs and parent-owned cleanup. Process mandatory scheduled ends before a simultaneous new optional crossing. Each crossing commits once; callback duplicate returns its existing receipt. Loops require new real movement costs and actor opportunities, never a recursive free transit. No nested-source cleanup may delete external identities or refund spent costs. Cross-source conflict uses current actual initiative order, then predeclared stable IDs outside initiative. Hidden preflight does not expose protected site/type/ward data. Unsupported nested-anchor relationships remain precise holds pending a compatible source contract.

PG9-Q30 — Select full authored procedures plus all original case obligations and distinct source-qualified branches. Preserve exact native card JSON unchanged alongside every NEW clause. Conditional fixture bodies and terrain are not asserted campaign facts. Acceptance requires the demonstrated branches, source access, clocks and inverses; a green checksum never substitutes for a missing semantic witness. Source/content/geometry/runtime/implementation/human-play/balance/cosmology/domain/completion/release boundaries persist. No canonical changes or application.

GATE129-ADD01 — Adopt the exact spell-local predicates stated in PG9-Q05/Q12/Q17/Q27; do not generalize Transport6. Demonstrate whole graph crossing and separately finite occupied closure, including current anatomy and absence; preserve required case and hold coverage.

operationalCard.activation: Reaction — when another creature you can perceive within range and line of effect begins casting a spell, after its casting costs and cadence are committed but before its effect resolves
operationalCard.targets: One pending spell cast by the triggering creature. The spell needs an actual recorded rank; the Director may know that rank without revealing it to you.
operationalCard.resolution: make a spellcasting-ability check using the actual ability for the class through which you cast Counterspell, adding PB once, against DC 10 + twice the triggering spell's actual rank (rank 0 contributes 0). Use CORE_RESOLUTION_PLAYTEST.md's fixed-DC task degrees and natural shifts: at least DC+10 Critical Success, at least DC Success, at most DC-10 Critical Failure, otherwise Failure; natural 20 improves one degree and natural 1 worsens one. Collapse both upper degrees to success and both lower degrees to failure; invent no additional critical effect. This is not a spell attack or saving throw.
operationalCard.effect: Success negates the selected pending spell after its costs were committed; failure lets it continue. Every interruptible cast first commits its RP/material/other costs, components, concentration transition, Dissonance/Refrain and exact beginning/casting hooks once, then opens the interruption window. A surviving cast later resolves its effect and outcome-dependent hooks. Negation gives no refund, no successful-effect trigger and no restoration of old concentration. Counterspell is itself a spell and can be countered. Resolve nested counters last-in, first-out; if a counter is negated, the earlier pending spell resumes without paying or casting again. Resuming a parent never rewrites the later nested cast's Refrain/Dissonance history.
operationalCard.scaling: None. No automatic success against lower ranks and no generic upcast.
operationalCard.limitations: One attempt per creature against a particular pending cast, shared across ordinary, Wizard, Mage and other same-named Counterspell sources. An exact source that expressly grants an additional Counterspell attempt against the same pending cast overrides this default; merely granting another Reaction does not. After a failed attempt another eligible creature may react; once negated, the spell supplies no further interruption trigger. All reactions need their own legal remaining resource, components, range and current source permissions. Attempting does not reveal spell identity/rank; never treat an unassigned rank as 0 or estimate it from RP. Ready opens its cast-interruption window at preparation, not release. Countering is not whole-Action/turn hard denial and does not spend that ledger. Ordinary Counterspell requires ordinary repertoire/class access and rank-3 cost; Wizard/Mage same-named class cards keep their own separate acquisition, printed costs, ranks, recharge and text. Apply SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md for actual class access and repertoire, costs before resolution, components, concentration, Dissonance/Refrain and exact source cadence. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.
operationalCard.designNotes: PRESERVED: both Abjuration/Universal rank-3 placements, Reaction, 60 feet, V/S/F and instantaneous interruption. NEW: actual casting ability+PB against DC 10+2*rank, one attempt per pending cast, hidden-rank handling and nested timing. REVIEWED SOURCE CORRECTION: the earlier binary-check proposal is superseded by the existing Core fixed-DC task rule, with natural shifts and collapsed success/failure outcomes. Exact source permission may override the shared attempt limit; another Reaction alone cannot.

card.name: Gust
card.targets: One visible Medium-or-smaller creature, one unattended object weighing at most 5 lb, or one harmless air effect in a 5-foot cube within range.
card.resolution: Creature: STR save against spell DC; failure permits the push, success no movement. Object/harmless modes need no roll.
card.effect: Push the selected creature 5 feet directly away from the caster into legal space. No damage or Prone rider; normal destination hazards apply. Forced movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks unless an exact rule says otherwise. Alternatively move the selected object 5 feet away along a clear path without attack damage; or briefly disperse ordinary smoke in the cube or extinguish one candle. Cannot end magical clouds, defeat weather, create ongoing breathable air or change a sound spell.
card.limitations: No automatic level scaling, generic upcast or new action budget. Use the actual casting source's access, components, costs, shared concentration and Dissonance/Refrain, then the legal interruption window. Countering or later failure refunds no committed use/payment or displaced concentration. Spell attacks use d20 + PB + actual source casting modifier; saves use DC 8 + PB + that modifier. Actual defenses, critical rules, core conditions, ordinary life-state rules and source-specific callbacks retain their scopes. Total cover prevents targeting unless this card expressly allows otherwise. For ancestry casts use ANCESTRY_BACKGROUND_PLAYTEST.md; existing ordinary identities retain their actual class/school/rank access and RP price.
